discordPostHtml:
This mod adds portraits of most characters from the game Library of Ruina. Integrating some of them into the some of the vanilla factions.

The ones that are too out there for starsector are a separate download and are only in the player faction.

Download: https://github.com/FluffyTowels/Starsector-LoR_Portraits/releases/download/1.1.0/LoR_portraits_1.1.0.zip
Download Distortions: https://github.com/FluffyTowels/Starsector-LoR_Portraits_Distortion/releases/download/1.0.0/LoR_portraits_distortion_1.0.0.zip
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=31235.0
aiDescription: Includes portraits for most characters from Library of Ruina. Characters deemed too out of place are available in a separate download and are restricted to the player faction.
